basics.name: Shun-Hsiang Hsu
basics.label: Ph.D. Student at UIUC
basics.summary: Machine learning research in multimodal learning, computer vision, geometry-grounded synthetic data, and LLM evaluation. Experience in controlled experiments, benchmarking, model adaptation, and research prototypes.

work.name: Google
work.summary: Summer 2026 · LLM evaluation and skill-based agent systems.
highlights: Designed controlled experiments and refined scoring rubrics for an LLM autorater, achieving over 90% repeated-evaluation score consistency and over 90% alignment with human ratings.
Designed a graph representation of agent skills to encode sequencing and dependencies for relationship-aware retrieval, orchestration, and skill-library health checks.
brief: LLM autorater experiments and rubrics: over 90% repeated-score consistency and over 90% alignment with human ratings.
Designed agent skill graphs for sequencing, retrieval, and orchestration.

work.name: Reconstruct Inc.
work.summary: Computer vision and 3D method evaluation, model adaptation, and training iteration.
highlights: Built controlled image-matching and 3D reconstruction benchmarks under low-texture, repeated-pattern, sparse-view, and illumination-shift conditions to guide production method selection.
Integrated FiLM-conditioned camera-orientation cues into a Swin Transformer segmentation model and trained inspection models through an internal active-learning pipeline.
brief: Benchmarked image matching and 3D reconstruction under challenging visual conditions.
Adapted Swin segmentation with FiLM orientation cues; trained models through the existing active-learning pipeline.

work.name: TryTech Co., Ltd.
work.summary: LLM applications, human-AI workflows, and industry prototypes.
highlights: Built a customer-support LLM backend prototype with retrieval, tool orchestration, transaction workflows, and human handoff.
Prototyped inspection applications with iOS and web interfaces and deployed machine-learning and custom algorithm modules on AWS using SAM and Lambda for industry pilots.
brief: Built customer-support LLM prototypes with retrieval, tools, transactions, and human handoff.
Developed inspection applications and deployed AWS SAM/Lambda modules for industry pilots.

work.name: NCREE–NTUCE Joint AI Research Center
highlights: Led six industry research projects developing and deploying deep-learning inspection systems for concrete and steel structures, integrating visual recognition into field inspection and near-real-time reporting.
brief: Led six industry research projects on deep-learning inspection of concrete and steel structures.
Integrated visual recognition into field inspection and near-real-time reporting.

research.name: Geometry-Grounded Synthetic Data for Visual Recognition
research.summary: Parameterized 3D defect models generate rendered imagery, pixel-level masks, and physical defect attributes without manual annotation.
highlights: Developed a synthetic-data framework that derives supervision directly from controllable defect geometry.
Generated 72K synthetic crack images and evaluated transfer across three public real-image segmentation benchmarks; realism enhancement improved zero-shot IoU by 3.7–13.6 points.
Developing a CAD-referenced extension for multi-view appearance and geometry representations, matching, and few-shot asset recognition.

research.name: Vision-Language Learning for Visual Reporting and Reasoning
research.summary: Vision-language models and datasets for generating and evaluating reports from visual observations.
highlights: Co-developed VisualSiteDiary, a detector-free vision-language Transformer for construction photolog captioning and image retrieval (equal contribution).
Developed VL-Con, a construction vision-language dataset and few-shot prompting framework using in-domain visual-text demonstrations.
Evaluated single- and multi-agent vision-language workflows for inspection reporting, including model-generated self-assessment to identify low-quality outputs.

projects.name: LLM Evaluation and Agent Workflows
projects.summary: Controlled experiments and rubric iteration for an autorater of troubleshooting hypotheses; agent skill-graph design.
highlights: Compared scoring formulations and rubric-grounded prompts, using disagreement analysis to refine the evaluator.
Achieved over 90% repeated-evaluation score consistency and over 90% alignment with human ratings on the evaluated tasks.
Designed a graph representation of skill sequencing and dependencies for relationship-aware retrieval, orchestration, and library checks.

projects.name: Vision Model Adaptation and Benchmarking
projects.summary: Controlled benchmarks and model adaptation for infrastructure and facility imagery.
highlights: Compared image-matching and 3D reconstruction methods under low-texture, repeated-pattern, sparse-view, and illumination-shift conditions.
Integrated FiLM-conditioned camera-orientation cues into Swin Transformer segmentation and extended inspection-specific object classes.
Trained and iterated on domain-specific recognition models using the company's existing active-learning pipeline.

projects.name: Applied AI Prototypes and Human Handoff
projects.summary: Customer-support prototype integrating retrieval, tools, backend transactions, and human escalation.
highlights: Built the LLM backend and agent-console handoff for an omnichannel support prototype.
Developed conversation-analysis workflows and an embedding-based classifier for identifying effective service utterances.
In separate inspection projects, built iOS and web interfaces and deployed modules on AWS using SAM and Lambda for industry pilots.
